Steps 10 onward (second review, reconciliation sign-off, release) are not done. No withholding schedule or determination rows existed, and nothing has been written to the database (read-only access).

DISTRIBUTION AND RECONCILIATION (control C3.4)
- Notice DOC-0202: record date 2026-12-15, payment date 2027-01-12, USD 8,000,000.
- One component, D-002-A: US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing Inc. (a US corporation). It passed through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (disregarded, holds 80% of Orion) and arrived as payments P-009/P-010.
- The 12 payee lines add up to 8,000,000. They match the unit percentages at the record date.
- Schedule totals: gross 8,000,000; tax 1,175,900; net 6,824,100.
- Atlas Lux Feeder (I-002) and Sterling Nominees (I-007) are transparent or intermediaries. Their lines are split to the owners whose income it is: I-010, I-011 and I-012, and I-013 and I-014. The cash still goes to those two intermediaries as payees.

RULE VERSIONS ON THE PAYMENT DATE
- R-01 v2026.1 (30%) and R-02 v2027.1 (Luxembourg treaty 10%, Protocol Art. 3, in force from 2027-01-01).
- Data issue: R-02 v2026.1 (15%) also has no end date in the rulebook, so it overlaps v2027.1. I used v2027.1 on the payment date. The rulebook needs v2026.1 end-dated 2026-12-31.
- No obligation_assessment rows exist for any recipient.

REDUCED RATES THAT NEED REVIEW (control C3.3)
- Eight Luxembourg treaty lines at 10%: I-001, I-003, I-004, I-005, I-008, I-010, plus I-013 if cured.
- The 5% rate (R-03 v2026.1, at least 10% effective vote in the paying company) was not applied to anyone.
  (a) I-003 Kirchberg: effective vote is 12.5% x 80% = exactly 10.0%. However, its units moved to class A2 on 2026-12-01 under side letter DOC-0003, which is not digitised. Its effect on voting is unknown, so FR-06 cannot be confirmed.
  (b) I-010 Ardennes: the feeder's vote in the fund is 25% from 2026-12-01 in entity_mgmt holding H-005b, but 24% in investor_register commitment C-002. At 25%, I-010's effective vote is 25% x 50% x 80% = 10.0%; at 24% it is 9.6%. The conflicting records need resolving.
  Whether R-03 allows looking through the fund partnership is a judgement for the reviewer.
- 10% is the conservative choice. If either investor is confirmed at 5%, re-run step 9.

DEFAULTS. Five lines, tax 508,800. Investor relations must notify each before payment (control C3.7). Hold was not used: the LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised, so no hold right could be confirmed.
- I-011 Moselle: residence moved to Belgium on 2026-12-01 (DOC-0111, not digitised). Needs a new W-8BEN-E, possibly claiming the Belgian treaty. That treaty is not in the rulebook.
- I-006 Meridian I: change case K-006 is still open. The new ownership is circular, and the ultimate owner is a Jersey trust, so the ownership/base-erosion limitation-on-benefits test probably fails even after the facts are complete. Needs a full ownership chain and a fresh limitation-on-benefits analysis.
- I-013 Echternach: form F-013 ends 2026-12-31, before the payment date (scenario S3.5). DOC-0107 and tax status TS-013 (from 2025-03-04) point to a W-8BEN-E of 2025-03-04 that is not on file. Get it from Sterling or Echternach and validate it before 2027-01-12. If that happens, the line becomes 10% (tax 30,000).
- I-014 Client account 7731: needs a beneficial-owner certification.
- I-015 Bertrange: needs a new W-8BEN-E.
- I-011 and I-013 have been passed to WF2 with 2027-01-12 as the deadline. If they are cured before the step 9 cut-off (3 business days before payment), re-determine those lines.

OTHER DATA POINTS
- I-016 is 3% in the investor register and distribution line, but 3.5% in entity_mgmt holding H-006. Paid as 3%; fund finance should confirm.
- F-002, the feeder's W-8IMY, has no document reference or withholding statement on file. The partner split of 50/30/20 is taken from the ALF1 commitments.
- I-008 and I-009 share the name "Alpha Holdings SA" but are different entities (Luxembourg and Switzerland). Check the payee mapping: CP-108 is I-008 and CP-109 is I-009.
- Date anomaly: the system date is 2026-10-15, but DOC-0202 (2026-12-07), DOC-0003 (2026-11-24), DOC-0111 (2026-12-18) and the I-011 residence record (recorded 2026-12-20) all postdate it. Confirm the as-of date before sign-off.
- The second reviewer must not be the preparer (control C3.5). The clearances were reviewed by STAFF-02 and STAFF-03."}
